name_am: የሴቶች መጠለያና ልማት ማኅበር (AWSAD) መጠለያ፣ ሀዋሳ
location_description_en: Hawassa. The safe house location is not public. Ask the Dilla one-stop centre, the police or the 7711 hotline for a referral.
location_description_am: ሀዋሳ። የመጠለያው ቦታ ለሕዝብ ይፋ አይደለም። ከዲላ የተቀናጀ አገልግሎት ማዕከል፣ ከፖሊስ ወይም ከ7711 መስመር ሪፈራል ይጠይቁ።
source_name: UNFPA Ethiopia — "Joint Donor Mission to Hawassa and Dilla Strengthens Support for Women's and Youth Health and Protection Services" (10 June 2024)
source_text_original: From June 4 to 5, 2024, a high-profile joint donor mission visited UNFPA-supported interventions in Hawassa and Dilla towns. … Finally, delegates also visited the AWSAD's Safehouse in Hawassa, providing comprehensive support to GBV survivors. … The second day included a courtesy visit to the Vice President of the Regional Government of Sidama.

additional_sources.name: UNFPA Ethiopia — "GBV survivors receiving integrated response services as part of UNFPA supported programme" (10 November 2022)
additional_sources.note: "referred … to the UNFPA supported safe house in Hawassa which is run by the Association for Women Sanctuary and Development."

notes_en: Entry is by referral. No phone number is published for this safe house; AWSAD's Addis Ababa office numbers are listed on the Addis Ababa AWSAD entry.
notes_am: መግቢያ በሪፈራል ነው። ለዚህ መጠለያ ስልክ ቁጥር አልተገለጸም፤ የAWSAD የአዲስ አበባ ቢሮ ቁጥሮች በአዲስ አበባው የAWSAD ዝርዝር ላይ አሉ።

name_en: EWLA Hawassa office — free legal aid
name_am: የኢትዮጵያ የሴቶች ሕግ ባለሙያዎች ማኅበር (EWLA) ሀዋሳ ቢሮ – ነፃ የሕግ ድጋፍ
location_description_en: Hawassa, around the Women's and Children's Affairs office.
location_description_am: ሀዋሳ፣ በሴቶችና ሕፃናት ጉዳይ ቢሮ አካባቢ።
source_text_original: Hawassa Around Women’s and Children’s Affair’s office SNNPR, Ethiopia Tel: 0462204800 … We provide free legal advice and representation to all women and girls, ensuring equitable access to justice across both development and crisis-affected environments.

additional_sources.name: EWLA — Annual Report 2023 (published June 2024)
additional_sources.note: "has opened its regional offices in seven regions and one city administration namely Adama, Hawassa, Bahir Dar, Gambella, Asosa, Jigjiiga, Semera regions and city administration of Dire Dawa."

notes_en: For women and girls. Hours are not stated. Number normalised to international format. The source still names SNNPR; Hawassa is now in Sidama region (UNFPA, June 2024: "the Regional Government of Sidama").
notes_am: ለሴቶችና ልጃገረዶች። የሥራ ሰዓት አልተገለጸም። ቁጥሩ ወደ ዓለም አቀፍ ቅርጽ ተቀይሯል። ምንጩ አሁንም ደቡብ ብሔሮች (SNNPR) ይላል፤ ሀዋሳ አሁን በሲዳማ ክልል ነው (UNFPA፣ ሰኔ 2024)።
